summary: Verified global inline Google Ads tag (AW-18460200148) integration with native analytics module cooperating via existing loader. Raw-HTML (curl) checks on /, /consulting, /contact, /careers and admin isolation on /admin, /admin/dashboard all pass. Live-browser DOM/dataLayer/network checks on home, SPA nav (/contact via CTA, /about-us, /careers via pushState), click rules (outbound LinkedIn, mailto, plain internal privacy), generate_lead on /consulting-9 (POST /api/contacts/submit mocked via page.route) and admin isolation at /admin all pass with no console errors.

verifications.console_errors: none related to analytics/CSP; one unrelated 401 on admin session probe when visiting /admin unauthenticated (expected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Inline Google Ads tag (AW-18460200148) is correctly in <head> of index.html with data-testid='google-ads-tag-script' + 'google-ads-tag-config' and nonce matching CSP header per request. Native analytics module reuses the existing loader (no second googletagmanager script), configures only GT-PLHLCK7D with send_page_view:false, and sends the FIRST page_view with send_to:['GT-PLHLCK7D']; subsequent SPA page_views omit send_to. Admin routes are completely stripped of gtag/dataLayer. Mock POST /api/contacts/submit via page.route when testing generate_lead; never submit live. REACT_APP_GOOGLE_ADS_CONVERSION_LABEL is empty so no 'conversion' event is expected.
